name: halls_tiles
direction: B, late NES polish: bold dark outlines, three tone shading lit from the top left
rule: NES: one shared backdrop $0F, four background palettes of three entries, a 16x16 area carries at most three colours besides the backdrop, at most 25 colours on screen; every pixel is a 2C02 output and the tool refuses anything else

blood_3.why: $07 #881400, the dark brick face and iron after dark

blood_4.why: $17 #e45c10, the brick face under the lamp and painted rail

gold_2.why: $18 #ac7c00, the olive gold of a board in the middle of its ramp

gold_4.why: $28 #f8b800, pale gold: a lit board and lamp glass

gold_5.why: $38 #f8d878, the hot core of a window and lit lettering

grey_3.why: $2D #787878, the darker neutral the road's tarmac spends

grey_4.why: $00 #7c7c7c, the one neutral mid grey in the 2C02: plaster in shade and wet stone

grey_5.why: $10 #bcbcbc, the lighter neutral: lit plaster and a wet slab's sheen

ink.why: the canonical black $0F, the shared backdrop of every area

paper.why: $20 #f8f8f8, the white of a mullion, lane paint and a shirt

sea_1.why: $0C #004058, the darkest cool output: joints, shadow, deep water

sea_3.why: $21 #3cbcfc, azure: the shaded sky in a window

sea_4.why: $31 #a4e4fc, pale azure: the lit sky in a window

stone_2.why: $08 #503000, the brown one step under brick: mortar, joints, dark wood

halls_day.note: the Montefiore halls room in daylight: cold plaster, pale boards, the sky in two windows

palettes.name: bg0_hall_wall
palettes.note: cold plaster, the dado rail, the skirting and the door: one grey ramp, lit from the top left

palettes.name: bg1_hall_glass
palettes.note: the window: the frame in paper, the lit sky in pale azure, the shaded sky in azure

palettes.name: bg2_hall_floor
palettes.note: the boards, the rug, the cartons and the chair: one warm ramp so the floor spends one group
